verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's first-party docs describe adding targeting conditions to rules that are evaluated against attributes passed into the SDK. They also describe targeting with user attributes, conditions, saved groups (reusable segments) and percentage rollouts, layering several rules on one feature, and assigning the same variation for the same attributes across all SDKs. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how saved groups are defined and reused (they appear only in a one-line summary), independent or hands-on corroboration of targeting rules and segments.
